description: This file defines a static helper class 'TestConfig' for loading environment variables and configuration settings used in API tests. It loads environment variables from a '.env' file if present, and provides static properties to access various configuration values such as BaseUrl, API paths, credentials, and flags for mock modes.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A static class providing environment-based configuration for API testing, including loading from a .env file and exposing properties for URLs, credentials, and flags.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable by key with a default fallback; trims whitespace.
